## Summary
- Default direct agent response model metadata footers to visible when `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL` / `display_model` is unset.
- Preserve `false` as the explicit opt-out.
- Suppress duplicate Codex reasoning text when the effective model id already encodes it, e.g. show `gpt-5.5/xhigh` without an additional `xhigh` footer field.
- Update action metadata, docs, and envelope coverage.

## Tests
- `cd .agent && npm test`

Stacked on #389. Supersedes #387 with the Codex model-id display cleanup included.

Closes #385.

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: 02c87cc9cf850a8786c1866fb78cf0ed90f9f24e -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

I now have everything I need. The rubrics-review file has an API auth failure, but that review already ran and was posted to the PR as a comment (scored PASS 100/100). No existing inline review threads. Let me write the synthesis.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #390 flips the `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL` / `display_model` action input default from opt-in (hidden) to opt-out (visible), so model/provider metadata footers appear on direct agent response comments by default without any per-repo configuration. It also adds a `displayReasoningEffort` helper that suppresses a duplicate reasoning-effort field when the Codex model ID already encodes it (e.g., `gpt-5.5/xhigh`). The change is stacked on #389 ("Pin provider model defaults"), which is still open. Documentation, action metadata, and envelope coverage assertions are updated to match.

## Review

One concrete code review ran successfully (claude-review-390). The rubrics-review run encountered an API authentication error; however, an earlier rubrics review run already posted a PASS (100/100, 8 rubrics) directly to the PR. The implementation is correct, well-scoped, and has no blocking issues.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Double-default is intentional | INFO | `action.yml` has both `default: "true"` on the input and `\|\| 'true'` in the env step; both are necessary to handle the empty-string passthrough case from the 20 callers using `${{ vars.AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL \|\| '' }}`. |
| Hardcoded reasoning-level enumeration | INFO | `CODEX_REASONING_MODEL_SUFFIX` hardcodes `low\|medium\|high\|xhigh`; a new Codex reasoning level would require a matching regex update to suppress the duplicate footer field. |
| Tests are structural, not behavioral | INFO | `envelope.test.ts` additions verify call-site patterns and symbol names, not behavioral edge cases; `displayReasoningEffort` branching is not unit-tested, consistent with the existing test style. |
| Stack dependency on #389 | INFO | PR is explicitly stacked on #389 (still open); merge order must be respected. |

## Progress

- Rubrics review already posted to PR as a top-level comment (PASS, 100/100 across 8 rubrics).
- All 20 calling workflows already use `${{ vars.AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL || '' }}`, so the rollout to default-visible is uniform upon merge.
- Doc update in `configuration-list.md` accurately reflects the new default.
- `parseBooleanFlag(value, defaultValue)` extension and `displayReasoningEffort` helper are correctly scoped — no over-suppression for Claude models.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Double-default is intentional</summary>

**Cause:** GitHub Actions composite actions do not apply the declared `default:` when a caller passes an explicit empty string. The 20 calling workflows use `${{ vars.AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL || '' }}` which resolves to `""` when the variable is unset, bypassing the input-level default. The `|| 'true'` env expression is the actual handler for that case.

**Candidate solutions:** The current approach is the correct one. An optional inline comment could clarify the two-layer intent for future maintainers.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hardcoded reasoning-level enumeration</summary>

**Cause:** `CODEX_REASONING_MODEL_SUFFIX = /(?:\/(?:low|medium|high|xhigh)|\[(?:low|medium|high|xhigh)\])$/u` enumerates every Codex reasoning level. A new level (e.g., `ultra`) would not be suppressed, resulting in a footer showing the level twice.

**Candidate solutions:** Acceptable maintenance exposure; no action required now. If Codex adds new levels, update the regex. A comment noting that the list must stay in sync with Codex API reasoning levels would reduce future confusion.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Tests are structural, not behavioral</summary>

**Cause:** The repo's existing `run.ts`-related test style uses string-match assertions on source text rather than unit tests of exported functions. The new assertions follow this pattern.

**Candidate solutions:** No action required to ship. If coverage is expanded later, `displayReasoningEffort` has enough branching (agent check, model suffix check, empty-string guard) to benefit from a small unit test.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Stack dependency on #389</summary>

**Cause:** PR #390 is explicitly scoped as stacking on #389; it supersedes #387. No code correction needed — merge order is the only gate.

**Candidate solutions:** Merge #389 first, then merge #390.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` — No unresolved code issues remain; merge is gated on #389 landing first, which is a human sequencing decision, not a branch change needed in this PR.
